description: Mobile Viewport UI Optimization, Delivered Order Tracking Guard, and Real-Time Dynamic Order Lifecycle Progression with Countdown ETA

userStories.title: Optimize UI Layout and Status Badges to Fit Phone Screens Seamlessly
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I want cards, text, and status badges in the Past Orders and Order Tracking screens to fit neatly on narrow phone screens without overflow or clipping.
acceptanceCriteria: Past order cards fit cleanly on mobile widths (320px - 430px) without horizontal clipping
Status badges use concise labels ('Preparing', 'Out for Delivery', 'Confirmed', 'Delivered') and compact padding to prevent edge overflow
Order header rows use Flexible/Expanded layouts to gracefully handle long branch names and order IDs
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Responsive cards, expanded columns, and concise status badges formatted to fit 320px-430px mobile screens without overflow.

userStories.title: Conditionally Guard Live Tracking Button for Delivered Orders
userStories.description: As a customer, I do not want to see a 'Live Tracking' button for orders that have already been delivered.
acceptanceCriteria: In PastOrdersScreen, hide the 'Live Tracking' button when order.status == OrderStatus.delivered
Display a clean 'Delivered' checkmark indicator / completed receipt badge for delivered orders
Only display the 'Live Tracking' button for active, undelivered orders (confirmed, preparing, out for delivery)
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Delivered orders omit the live tracking button and display a green check 'Delivered' badge.

userStories.title: Implement Real-Time Dynamic Order Lifecycle Progression & ETA Countdown
userStories.description: As a customer ordering food, I want to see an initial estimated delivery time and have the order status automatically progress through processing, delivering, and delivered stages over time.
acceptanceCriteria: Newly placed orders calculate an estimated delivery window (e.g. 20-25 mins) and elapsed time
OrdersNotifier manages a real-time periodic lifecycle ticker that transitions orders: Confirmed -> Kitchen Preparing -> Out for Delivery -> Delivered
Dynamic ETA countdown in OrderScreen updates remaining time in real-time (e.g., '20-25 Mins' -> '15 Mins' -> '5 Mins' -> 'Delivered')
Live timeline steps in OrderScreen reflect the active progression stage automatically
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: OrdersNotifier periodically transitions order lifecycle and updates dynamic ETA and timeline.

userStories.title: Execute Test Suite, Update Regression Tests, and Compile Flutter Web Build
userStories.description: As a developer, I want all unit & widget tests to pass and the Flutter Web release to be built and deployed.
acceptanceCriteria: Widget tests in past_orders_test.dart verify that delivered orders do not show the Live Tracking button
Widget tests verify dynamic lifecycle stage progression and ETA calculations
All 17+ Flutter tests pass (flutter test)
Flutter Web production build completes and outputs to public/flutter_web/
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: 18/18 tests passing in flutter test and production web build deployed.
